title: Easy to Drive and Use
summary: Reviews in this topic mainly praise the G60 for being easy to drive, easy to handle, and simple to use, with a few also noting an easy buying process.

positive.summary: Positive reviews describe the car as easy to drive and handle, with user-friendly technology and a straightforward purchase process.

undetermined.summary: One undetermined review mentions monitoring, but the fragment does not provide enough context to identify a clear sentiment or concrete aspect evaluation.

limitations: The topic combines several related but distinct aspects, including ease of driving, ease of using technology or features, and ease of the buying process.
Examples are limited, so the evidence is not sufficient to say which of these aspects is most prominent beyond the sampled fragments.
